text: 2026年三季度最后一个交易日已结束，市场进入2026年三季报披露筹备期，据各大交易所官网数据显示，目前共有177家IPO审核状态为中止。其中，上交所占据58家(主板11家，科创板47家)、北交所占据119家。值得一提的是，仅9月30日便有58家IPO审核状态集中变更为“中止(财报更新)”，从原因来看，均为发行上市申请文件中记载的财务资料已过有效期，需要补充提交。
text_en: The last trading day of the third quarter of 2026 has ended, and the market has entered the preparatory period for disclosure of 2026 third-quarter reports. According to data from the official websites of major exchanges, a total of 177 IPO review statuses are currently suspended. Among them, the Shanghai Stock Exchange accounts for 58 (11 on the main board and 47 on the STAR Market), and the Beijing Stock Exchange accounts for 119. It is worth noting that on September 30 alone, 58 IPO review statuses were changed in a concentrated manner to "suspended (financial report update)." The reason in each case was that the financial information recorded in the issuance and listing application documents had expired and needed to be supplemented and submitted.
